image_description: A close-up shot of a hand holding a white Apple iPod Classic. The device features a black screen on the upper half displaying a blue graphic logo, and a white click wheel interface on the lower half. The background consists of blurred bookshelves filled with books and framed artwork.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The screen displays a stylized blue graphic that resembles text or a logo but is illegible and lacks the sharpness of a real digital display. It does not show a coherent UI.
The skin texture on the fingers appears slightly waxy and overly smooth. The pattern on the blue sleeve cuff is indistinct and lacks clear fabric weave definition, suggesting minor generative blur.
The central 'MENU' button text is faint and slightly distorted, lacking the crisp embossing found on physical devices.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model generation (Classic) and distinguish it from similar rectangular media players.
To analyze the illegible blue graphic on the screen and determine if it constitutes failed text rendering.
To verify the sharpness of the device boundaries against the hand and background, checking for edge bleeding.
To assess the overall realism of lighting, reflections on the screen, and hand anatomy.

focus_areas: Screen content legibility and UI realism
Edge sharpness of the device casing
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the screen content. Real iPods have high-resolution screens; AI often fails to render crisp UI text, resulting in 'gibberish' graphics. Also, inspect the hand holding the device for anatomical correctness, as fingers wrapping around objects are common failure points for structural integrity.
